_readme: IGE_DW_PST_LEFT_TT-T.json — IGLO EDGE family, Double Window (Parametric). This file is the single source of truth for all junction logic for a two-sash double window where the LEFT sash is tilt-and-turn (open + tilt) and the RIGHT sash is turn-only (open only) with the Movable Post (PST) fixed rigidly to the right sash (SSH_RIGHT). The AI executor must read this file before generating any geometry. It must not infer, assume, or supplement any rule. If a junction type is not listed here, it must STOP and ask.

parametricDimensions._comment: All geometry is driven by these two values. Every placement coordinate must be derived from them. Do not hardcode any dimension.

splitRatio._comment: Fraction of opening width assigned to the LEFT sash. Default 0.5 = equal split. Must be between 0.2 and 0.8.

sash_left._comment: Left sash opens inward on the left hinge. It also tilts inward from the top. Hardware (hinges, tilt-turn fitting) is on the left stile and top rail.

sash_right._comment: Right sash opens inward on the right hinge. The Movable Post (PST) is rigidly bonded to the right sash meeting stile — it moves with the sash as one unit. Hardware (hinges) is on the right stile.

movablePostBehavior._comment: The PST is NOT a free-floating mullion in this configuration. It is mechanically fixed to the right sash (SSH_RIGHT) meeting stile and travels with it when the right sash opens. When both sashes are closed the PST sits centred on the split X position.

pst_ext_shortening._comment: PST_EXT is trimmed 75 mm shorter on both top and bottom so it clears the FRM_INT rebate shoulder when the sash swings.

pst_int_shortening._comment: PST_INT is trimmed 48 mm shorter on both top and bottom for the same reason.

closedPositionGap._comment: When both sashes are fully closed there must be a visible vertical gap of exactly 8 mm between the two meeting stiles, measured face-to-face on the interior side (toward the camera / room side). This gap is achieved by the geometry of the PST rebate nesting the sash stiles — do NOT close this gap with any additional profile or seal geometry.

frame_corner._comment: All four frame corners. 45° mitre. Reference point is the inner-face corner — cut line runs exactly from inner_face_corner outward at 45°. The outer face is trimmed to meet. No gap, no overlap permitted.

sash_corner._comment: All four corners on BOTH sashes. Same 45° mitre as frame corners. Sash inner-face corners must align with frame rebate edges — NOT with frame inner face.

movable_post_to_frame._comment: Post top and bottom butt squarely against the frame inner face (the rebate shoulder). Post runs full height of the frame opening. No mitre. Post end is cut 90° square. Because the PST is fixed to sash_right, this junction is evaluated only in the CLOSED position.

movable_post_to_sash_left._comment: The LEFT sash right stile nests INTO the left rebate face of the PST. The sash does NOT mitre against the post. The sash outer face aligns flush with the PST rebate shoulder. The sash end is NOT cut — it runs full height. The PST rebate depth must exactly match the sash_left right-stile outerFaceWidth. This junction is only active when sash_left is in the CLOSED position.

movable_post_to_sash_right._comment: The PST right rebate face is PERMANENTLY bonded to the right sash LEFT stile. This is a fixed mechanical bond, not a sliding or seasonal junction. The right sash left stile nests into the PST right rebate. The rebate depth must exactly match the sash_right left-stile outerFaceWidth.

glazing_bead_corner._comment: Glazing bead corners are 45° mitres, same reference convention as sash corners. Bead sits inside sash rebate on both sash_left and sash_right.

frame._comment: Frame is placed first. Its inner-face rectangle defines the opening. All other components are positioned relative to frame_opening. Total frame outer size = config.totalWidth × config.totalHeight.

movable_post._comment: Post X position is defined by the split ratio. Because the PST is fixed to sash_right, its X position also defines the right sash left edge. Post is centred on its own width at the split X. Post Y runs full frame opening height (frame_inner_face_bottom to frame_inner_face_top).

sash_left._comment: Left (tilt-and-turn) sash. Left outer face aligns with frame rebate left edge. Right stile nests into PST left rebate shoulder. Top and bottom align with frame rebate top/bottom edges. Width is parametric: (split_x - post_half_width) - frame_rebate_left.

sash_right._comment: Right (turn-only) sash. The PST right rebate shoulder defines its left edge. Right outer face aligns with frame rebate right edge. Top and bottom align with frame rebate top/bottom edges. The PST travels with this sash.

glazing_bead_left._comment: Glazing bead for sash_left. Sits inside the sash rebate. Inner face of bead is flush with sash_left inner face.

glazing_bead_right._comment: Glazing bead for sash_right. Sits inside the sash rebate. Inner face of bead is flush with sash_right inner face.

forbiddenBehaviors: Do not mitre the movable post against either sash — junction type is rebate_nest or rebate_nest_fixed only
Do not align sash corners to frame inner face — use frame_rebate_edge
Do not infer rebate depth from profile geometry — use dimensions.rebateDepth from metadata
Do not guess any missing value — stop and ask if any dimension or rule is undefined
Do not apply world coordinates directly — always transform through normalized_local origin first
Do not treat the movable post as a free-floating element — it is rigidly fixed to sash_right and moves with it
Do not close the 8 mm inter-sash gap with any seal, profile, or geometry — this gap is by design and must be preserved in the closed position
Do not apply PST_EXT or PST_INT at full height — they must be trimmed per pst_ext_shortening and pst_int_shortening rules respectively
Do not apply tilt hardware or tilt opening logic to sash_right — it is turn-only
Do not apply turn-right hardware to sash_left — it is tilt-and-turn with left-hand hinge only
